verdict.rationale: Independent reviews give a basic picture of efficiency: Tom's Hardware calls the chip "energy efficient" with strong productivity performance, and TechPowerUp says it has the best application performance and that the inverted cache stacking lets the cores shed heat directly to the cooler, which supports sustained clocks. However, the pack has no documented power envelope (TDP/PPT) and no long-duration throttling or per-watt measurements. missing for 10: first-party documented power envelope/TDP specs, independent sustained-load (long render/export) throttling tests, quantified performance-per-watt data.
